title: Bill Split Check
summary: Checks a bill split against the printed receipt so nobody is quietly overcharged by double-counted tax, a tip on a service charge or a missed item.
description: Checks an item-by-item split against the receipt and catches unclaimed items, tax counted twice, a tip on top of a service charge, a total that doesn't match and what an equal split costs the lightest eater, each with a fix and Undo. Shares are rounded so they always add up.
catches: Tax counted twice, or a tip added on top of a service charge
A split total that does not match the printed total (allowing for a round-off line)
How much an equal split costs the person who ordered least
Rounding drift, by largest-remainder rounding so shares add up exactly
limits: Works from the receipt lines you pass in; it does not read receipts
The tax-twice and wrong-total checks need the printed total
a11y: Per-person item toggles are buttons with aria-pressed and an aria-label naming person and item
Split mode is a role="radiogroup" with arrow-key navigation
The tip field has a <label> and aria-invalid when it duplicates a service charge
Status is announced in a role="status" region; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
stops: Tip added on top of service charge
mistakes: tip and service charge both paid
item nobody claimed on the bill
equal split unfair to light eater
